labeling.evidence: To obtain SILAC “heavy” labeled cell extracts, HEK293 Flp-In T-REx cells were grown in high glucose SILAC DMEM (PAA, E15-086) supplemented with 10% (v/v) dialyzed fetal bovine serum (Sigma Aldrich), 2 mM L-glutamine, 100 U/mL penicillin/streptomycin (both from Thermo Fisher Scientific), 0.398 mM 13C6,15N2 L-arginine, and 0.798 mM 13C6,15N2 L-lysine (Cambridge Isotope Laboratories) for at least seven passages.
